title: Audit Verify Post API Contract
description: Draft USF-native interface contract for POST /v1/audit/verify. It promotes the implemented local route metadata into canonical interface-contract coverage while preserving OpenAPI as a lower-authority projection.
aiGuidance: Treat this interface contract as the route authority. Do not infer semantic authority from OpenAPI, route metadata, examples, generated reports, or handler structure.
purpose: Represent audit-verify.post as a governed POST API route contract for audit-integrity-verifier.
boundary: Local dev/test inbound HTTP boundary POST /v1/audit/verify; implementation path apps/api/src/server.ts; route classification audit-sensitive.

requestContract.description: Request semantics for audit-verify.post bind method, path, operation id, request schema, auth scheme, tenant scope, and required action before implementation handling. Request schema: AuditVerifyRequest.

responseContract.description: Response semantics for audit-verify.post expose 200 AuditVerifyResponse, 400 ApiErrorResponse, 403 ApiErrorResponse; error responses use ApiErrorResponse. Audit, PDP, idempotency, rate-limit, correlation, field exposure, observability, gateway, and proof boundaries remain explicit contract terms.

security: Auth scheme dev-header-keycloak-bearer-future; tenant scope tenant-header-body; PDP policy audit query service calls PDP; audit policy verification request is audited; idempotency policy not-required; pagination policy none; rate-limit policy local-dev-test quotas represented; live enforcement deferred; field exposure policy minimum necessary fields; sensitive internals redacted; observability policy tenant-safe request_count error_count validation_failure_count auth_denial_count; gateway policy local-dev-test-only gateway-edge-waf-tls-production-posture-deferred; error schema ApiErrorResponse; proof status is bounded local-dev-test evidence with no public API or live-provider claim.
